# Blending

Blend grind marks and welds into the surrounding surface. Tell us your material, current process and target finish, and we will recommend the right product and grit sequence.

## Recommended products

- [Flap Disc](https://arsen-industrial.com/products/flap-disc.md): Flap disc for angle grinders that combines grinding and finishing in one step on welds, edges and flat surfaces.
- [Non-Woven Abrasive Wheel](https://arsen-industrial.com/products/non-woven-abrasive-wheel.md): Non-woven nylon abrasive wheel for deburring, blending and satin finishing on stainless steel, aluminium and other metals.
